name: veedstudio/open-edit
description: An open-source, agent-driven editing pipeline skill. The agent transcribes with real per-word timings, composes the piece as an HTML page, renders it frame by frame in a browser, reviews the frames and fixes what it sees, then hands back the file. It covers subtitles, motion graphics, slides, cutting and reframing, and rendered video.
install: npx skills add veedstudio/open-edit --skill open-edit (from README Get started section; gap-filled, see Gap fills)
